banner.description: I design and build complete web applications, from system architecture to interface detail.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description1: Hi! I'm Alex, a full stack developer. I've been doing this since 2021 and I get involved in the whole project: system architecture, backend logic, and the interface the user actually interacts with.
aboutMe.description2: I trained in multimedia design, and that shapes how I work. I don't think about technical decisions separately from product decisions.
aboutMe.description3: Right now I'm specializing in process automation: identifying repetitive manual tasks and solving them with software.

services.title: Services
services.webAppsDescription: Complete platforms: authentication, admin panels, integrations and APIs. From architecture design to final interface.
services.websitesDescription: Websites with their own admin so you can manage your content without depending on anyone.
services.automationDescription: Identifying and solving repetitive manual tasks within your operation.
